title: CarKeep - Vehicle Manager Privacy Policy - Lontyle Apps & Games

blocks.text: This Privacy Policy describes how CarKeep – Vehicle Manager (“we”, “our”, or “the app”) collects, uses, and protects personal information from users (“you” or “the user”) of our mobile application.
We do not collect personal information from users of our application.
We do not use any personal information as we do not collect it.
Our application does not collect any data automatically.
We do not share users’ personal information with third parties.
We do not collect or store personal information, so there is no need to implement security measures.
Since we do not collect personal information from users, privacy rights relating to personal data do not apply.

We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. We recommend that you review this page periodically for any changes. You acknowledge and agree that it is your responsibility to review this Privacy Policy periodically and become aware of modifications.
If you have any questions about our Privacy Policy, feel free to contact us in the Contact page
